name: What kind of paint finish should I choose for different rooms?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint finish should I choose for different rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal paint finish depends on the room's function and desired durability. Flat or matte finishes hide imperfections well and are suitable for low-traffic areas like bedrooms and dining rooms. Eggshell and satin finishes offer more durability and are easier to clean, making them popular for living rooms and hallways. Semi-gloss and gloss paints are highly durable and washable, ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, doors, and trim, where moisture and frequent cleaning are common concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose flat for low-traffic areas, eggshell/satin for living spaces, and semi-gloss/gloss for kitchens, bathrooms, and trim due to their durability and washability.
